mapper.select:
SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, c.member_id AS memberId, c.content AS content, c.official_yn AS officialYn, c.deleted_yn AS deletedYn, c.created_at AS createdAt,
m.name AS writerName, m.role AS writerRole FROM ins_comment c JOIN ins_member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY (c.official_yn = 'Y') DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ins_comment (board_id, member_id, content, official_yn, deleted_yn) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{officialYn}, 'N'), 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE ins_comment SET deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
